name: uv
role: every RoLA workspace's environment builder (rola_devtools' environment extension, its `python` tag): it installs the pinned Python (`python`) and syncs a lock's hash-pinned packages into the machine's shared store, one environment a key. A graph downloads it by this digest.
upstream: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv (the release's wheel on PyPI, by PyPI's digest: the wheel carries the uv binary)
